newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National 1996 pretax profit up to 1.228 billion pounds.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National 1996 pretax profit up to 1.228 billion pounds.

text.p: Abbey National plc, Britain's fifth largest bank, said on Thursday its 1996 pretax profit rose to 1.228 billion pounds ($2 billion), up from 1.026 billion in 1995.
The profit figure was slightly above analysts' expectations. It also announced a dividend payout of 26.1 pence per share compared to 21.75p in 1995.
The Abbey also said it would make a formal bid on Friday for mutually-owned life assurance firm Scottish Amicable.
In a statement accompanying its results, Abbey National said its strategy was to continue to focus on UK retail banking, consumer credit, life assurance and treasury and offshore.
It said it planned "further innovative development of both savings and mortgage products" in 1997 and extending its personal banking services in 1996.

Abbey shares took a tumble early this year as some analysts cut their recommendations after the stock had been on a bull run which in its turn, led to some securities houses recommending a purchase of the shares.
